about: Isolation run against the GenVM surface DEFINIT depends on. Each entry is one primitive exercised on its own against a throwaway probe contract, so the result of one cannot be attributed to another.
provenance: Structured restatement of an isolation run performed on 2026-09-17. The raw node stderr transcript was not retained; the observations below are the ones recorded at the time and they are the basis of the corresponding entry in docs/LIMITATIONS.md.

results.detail: The plain cross-contract read returns the full capability payload. This is the baseline that makes the next entry meaningful.
The call does not return a refusal. It stops returning, and the leader is killed with `Leader execution exceeded 600.000s`. This is the primitive the design wants and cannot have.

results.primitive: message emitted on the finalized stage
results.detail: A deferred message pinned to the finalized stage is accepted and delivered. This is what the deployed pair uses instead of the final-scoped read.

results.primitive: value transfer emitted on the finalized stage
results.detail: The transfer is accepted on the same stage. The first probe run reported `SystemError: 7: insufficient_balance`, which is a funding error in the probe, not a rejection of the primitive.

consequence: Both shipped contracts drop every use of StorageView.LATEST_FINALIZED. The execution boundary is instead two on-chain facts: the gate refuses to promote a decision until its appeal window has closed, and the vault re-derives that same window from the gate's own adjudication stamp before releasing. See docs/LIMITATIONS.md for what that boundary does and does not cover.
